falsifiers: A goal candidate must not transition into ACTIVE merely because model/cognitive output proposed it; ACTIVE adoption requires an explicit caller/control-plane supplied adoption evidence reference or an equally explicit external adoption token defined by the contract.

The Goal lifecycle must not expose a self-writable COMPLETED/VERIFIED_DONE terminal state. Dropping or retiring a goal must remain RETIRED/DROPPED_NOT_VERIFIED_COMPLETION unless CompletionGate supplies separate completion evidence.

Any attempt to embed or self-grant effect authorization/capability inside a Goal record or transition must fail closed or remain an opaque non-authoritative external reference; Goal state cannot become EffectGate authority.
Every mutation must reject stale or mismatched goal/state identity, generation, and state-digest fences and must advance generation exactly once on a valid transition.
A promotion transition that requires evidence must reject empty, malformed, ambiguous, or self-derived evidence references rather than silently normalizing them.
A DORMANT goal may carry an explicit wake-condition reference but the Goal lifecycle must not evaluate that condition, wake itself, or schedule Pulse actions; wake evaluation belongs to F2-WP-205.
Time passage alone must not silently promote, wake, retire, complete, or reprioritize a goal without an explicit admitted transition input.

Transition receipts must deterministically bind goal identity, prior generation/digest, requested transition, external evidence references, resulting generation/digest, and non-completion classification.
Canonicalization must make semantically unordered provenance/evidence-reference sets deterministic while preserving any field whose order is declared semantically meaningful.
Unknown lifecycle states, illegal transition edges, duplicate goal identities, and cross-goal transition receipts must fail closed.
